breakdown.description: The opposing horizontal tractions are reinterpreted as boundary-normal loads on the horizontal edges
breakdown.reason: The generated specification applies the ±1000 Pa tractions as boundary-normal loads on the horizontal edges (t = ±1000 n, acting in the y-direction), which is exactly the incorrect reinterpretation present in the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes this reinterpretation instruction, meaning the loads should be treated as x-directed (σ_xx) horizontal tractions as originally described. The agent repeated the error rather than fixing it.
